== Biography ==
'''Richard of Glasgow''' was a monk of Arbroath Abbey. He is named among the community in a record dated 3 July 1312.<ref>[https://poms.ac.uk/record/person/16356/ People of Medieval Scotland, Richard of Glasgow, monk], citing the Arbroath register.</ref>

The source gives no parentage or earlier history. His designation is a direct personal locative.

== Research Notes ==
The shared forename does not identify him with Richard de Glasgu admitted to Dublin's merchant guild more than a century earlier.
